Subject: Pricing + context-length follow-up: token profile, 8k/32k/128k needs, target $/1M

Hi Jane —

Great to meet on the call this morning. Thanks for walking through the workflow and use cases — super helpful. To move pricing and sizing forward we need a couple quick data points so we can put together a target unit-economics estimate (cost per 1M tokens) and capacity recommendation. Could you confirm the items below? A short reply is totally fine.

1) Average prompt tokens per request (mean) — ballpark is OK (e.g., 120 tokens)
2) Average completion tokens per request (mean)
3) Typical request distribution across context-length needs — are you primarily 8k, or do you expect 32k/128k sessions? If mixed, approximate % split.
4) Estimated monthly request volume (requests/month) or monthly token volume if you track that already (approx).
5) Budget range / target unit price — you mentioned wanting to get to <$X per 1M tokens on the call; can you share a target $/1M (even a range)?

We'll use this to: 1) recommend an 8k vs 32k vs 128k model profile, 2) show projected monthly token consumption and estimated Redwood list/unit pricing, and 3) surface Dedicated vs Hosted sizing options if you want predictable throughput.

I've attached a short token profiling CSV you can fill in if that's easier (acme_token_profile.csv).

Next steps: if you can send the numbers today/this week, I'll share a short draft estimate and mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and procurement steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the follow-up and the template — attached is a quick pass. High-level answers below (we're still validating some of these with engineering but this should be close):

1) Avg prompt tokens: ~140 tokens (most prompts include a short user message + 2 system lines + a 30–50 token instruction)
2) Avg completion tokens: ~600 tokens (typical output is a multi-paragraph summary + bullet list)
3) Context-length: about 75% of our traffic fits within 8k, 20% needs 32k, 5% will need 128k (these are sessions where we pass in full conversation history + multiple documents)
4) Estimated volume: currently ~200k requests/month; projected growth to ~1.2M requests/month in 12 months. Monthly token estimate today ~150M tokens/month, scaling to ~900M tokens/month at peak forecast.
5) Target $/1M tokens: we're hoping to be in the $X–Y range (we indicated ~$25–$40 / 1M tokens as a target benchmark) — open to tradeoffs if we do a committed contract.

I've attached the CSV (filled) — hope this helps. Happy to hop on a short call if you need clarifications.

Best,
Jane Doe
Director, AI Product
Acme Corp
jane.doe@acme.com
